rules.statement: A decision is res judicata between co-defendants when a plaintiff cannot obtain the relief he claims without an adjudication between the defendants, and such an adjudication is made not only between the plaintiff and the defendants but also between the defendants.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion formed after a careful examination of the authorities on the subject, the principle that a decision is not res judicata between co-defendants is subject to two exceptions : (a) When a plaintiff cannot obtain the relief he claims without an adjudication between the defendants and such an adjudication is made, not only between plaintiff and the defendants, but also between the defendants."
